name: Open-Source VoIP Calling Platform with AI Agents

mentions.name: Open-Source VoIP Calling Platform with AI Agents
mentions.description: Open-source calling platform built on VoIP that provides AI agents for making calls along with multiple features during the call, serving as an alternative to SaaS products like JustCall and CloudCall.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am trying to create an open-source alternative to JustCall and CloudCall. These SaaS products use VoIP as their foundation and provide AI agents for calling, along with multiple features during the call.
